items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: And I saw Fred Skinner about seven or eight months ago

ctx.x: At the Club Alabam. And you had people like Ned Stanfield, who was a piano player. Ned Stanfield was around here when I first came here, and he later went back into the profession. He's a doctor, and he played around Los Angeles in some of the spots as a single, you know. And also you have people like Dudley Brooks, Eddie Beal. These people were all here when I first came here. And Fred Skinner, who's another man who was quite a big -- who was quite a big name and a very popular local talent when I first came…
